headline: SBI Securities releases its 11 Diwali stock picks for Samvat 2083
summary: SBI Securities has published a list of 11 recommended stocks for investors ahead of Samvat 2083. The list spans large and small companies, including Tata Steel, Indian Hotels, MCX, Jyoti CNC, Sky Gold, Genus Power, Power Mech Projects, Centum Electronics, Stylam Industries, Sambhv Steel, and Lumax Industries. Retail investors tracking brokerage reports can use this list for festive portfolio additions.

headline: Tata Motors, HCL Tech, and others see activity on new orders
hook: Fresh orders drive momentum in key sectors
summary: Several companies including Tata Motors, HCL Technologies, and Sigma Advanced are seeing increased market activity following new order wins and global deal developments. The surge spans the infrastructure, technology, and defense manufacturing sectors. These developments reflect broader operational momentum for these firms. Retail investors should note that order book growth often serves as a leading indicator for future revenue performance.
why_it_matters: Order wins signal potential revenue growth for these listed companies.

headline: Genus Power sets October 30 record date for ₹148-crore buyback
hook: Buyback record date set for late October
summary: Genus Power Infrastructures has fixed October 30, 2026, as the record date for its proposed share buyback. The total size of the buyback is ₹148.20 crore, with the company offering ₹312 per share. Eligible shareholders holding shares as of the record date can participate in the offer. Indian retail investors holding the stock can tender their shares to realize value at the specified price.
whats_next: October 30, 2026 record date for the buyback
why_it_matters: Eligible shareholders can tender shares at ₹312 per share
winners_losers: Genus Power shareholders gain / company cash reserves reduced
